scope: Independent rehearsal of G7 staging readiness only; no real 2026 votes, national coverage attestation, data-ready or inference-ready approval.

findings.origin: COORD-G7-R1; independently reproduced by QA after candidate freeze
findings.title: Valid UTF-8 candidate names are rejected under the candidate's LC_ALL=C execution locale
findings.counterexample: The ASCII control CSV returns two rows. A CSV with identical fields except the valid UTF-8 candidate name JOSÉ DA CONCEIÇÃO returns Empty/missing vote values under LC_CTYPE=C, with invalid input found on input connection. A byte-preserving read plus explicit UTF-8 validation reads both rows under the same locale.
findings.evidence_boundary: The coordinator script and result are later evidence outside the 275-file frozen candidate manifest; the QA reproduction and raw inputs are in review/.
findings.impact: The declared UTF-8 intake fails on legitimate Brazilian candidate names in the tested environment, blocking routine official-data staging even after a normalized CSV is prepared.
findings.requested_change: Use locale-independent byte-preserving input and explicit UTF-8 validation/conversion; add a regression with non-ASCII candidate names under LC_ALL=C.

findings.title: Election date is checked only for year, not against the declared turn date
findings.counterexample: With all other fixture 2022 T1 identifiers, votes and controls unchanged, replacing EA11 pl.dt=02/10/2022 with 03/10/2022 produces staging_validated. The 2026 intake configuration likewise has no expected date for the documented T1 election.
findings.impact: An internally inconsistent election-date identity can be staged as validated; this does not mark data_ready, but violates the requested date preflight before external attestation.
findings.requested_change: Declare or independently resolve the expected election date by turn, compare EA11 pl.dt exactly, and test same-year wrong dates for T1 and conditional T2.

findings.title: The receipt does not state the territorial universe behind 100 percent EA16 coverage
findings.counterexample: A one-section EA16 roster, matching one-section vote file and one-section controls return staging_validated and complete=true, while omitting another fixture section. The receipt does not declare UF set or expected national universe.
findings.impact: Complete means complete relative to supplied EA16 references only. No national-real-coverage or data-ready claim was observed: both release booleans remain false.
findings.requested_change: Record the declared territorial scope and distinguish reference-relative completeness from independently attested national completeness in receipt and downstream instructions.

positive_controls: 275 distinct manifest files match bytes and SHA-256; run inventory is closed; static contract and DAG snapshot are frozen and the mutable ledger is not silently omitted from the declared freeze design.
G1 round2 manifest, review and adjudication match supplied hashes and both approvals are pass; G7 depends on G1 only while G2 remains changes_requested.

47 independent intake cases matched in the preserved final replay, including receipt/snapshot tampering, idempotence, revision, turn namespaces, invalid schema/codes/totals and forged official label with data_ready=false and inference_ready=false.
The strict coherent-2026 null-candidate case returned Candidate selection unresolved for turn at both validate and stage; it is not a helper bug.
G9 not_applicable without official non-occurrence attestation is rejected; gate-route labels return example_only and records_verified=false.
boundary_observations: The DAG checker accepts a copied G9=inconclusive ledger with G6/G7 still pending; this neither passes G9 nor authorizes inference and is outside the present staging disposition. The reviewed scenario examples used coherent predecessor labels only.

Eight two-writer stress attempts in the review store yielded one successful writer and one identifiable race failure each; all subsequent serial replays passed. An external lock or serial intake remains a stated operational requirement, not a demonstrated concurrent guarantee.

No approved raw-2026-to-normalized-section/candidate converter exists. EA18 locates section ballot files; EA20 is aggregate through zone, not a substitute. The adapter cannot by itself receive official raw files.
